scripts.preinstall: node -e "const u=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(!u.includes('pnpm')){console.error('Ce dépôt utilise pnpm : corepack enable pnpm ou npm i -g pnpm');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./frontend" --filter "./backend" --filter "./mockup-sandbox" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
